title: Combine Auritus and Babulus into one product, Babulus
description: Approved by Ryan 2026-11-02. One product and repo. Video with voiceover plus text to speech, using TTS APIs or local models. Cloud compute runs only when no local worker claimed the job and a spending check passed. Real Prospectus integration with a new Google project and quota backend. Milestones M0 to M7 are child tasks.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 2026-11-02: video rendering uses the same AWS Batch system as Auritus because it is simple, cheap and works. Extend the Auritus control plane rather than port it to TypeScript.
